label: BANDIT
comment: csdb release 174054, The Bandit. BASIC boot loads BLUE.C000 (starter), BLUE.B000-B400 (pages 0-3 of a running game) and BLUE.2800-9000 (memory dump). The starter copies the pages into place, fills $d100-$d1ff with an identity table, sets $01=$2d and jumps to $4000. Captured at $4000, game image $2800-$804c only.

label: DR
comment: csdb release 80080, Derbyshire Ram "+2": one packed file with a trainer menu (BOMBS CHEAT? FUEL CHEAT?) that patches the packed data. Its code at $8000 (CBM80 header) builds the identity table at $d100, the $0200 routine, $1100/$1130/$1142 and $0100, copies $1100-$11ff to $0300 and jumps to $4000; the game reaches $4126 first. Captured with both trainers on, game image $2800-$804c only. Title text "COPYRIGHT 1983 SYNSOFT".
